ride.title: Magic Ride
ride.about: Poem 10, the cel-shaded Genie take, rebuilt by Atlas in five places. His voice; his words as he says them.

arcade.title: Arcade walk
arcade.about: Genie street test, zone 091: he walks to the twin escalators, then the camera turns along the shopfronts. Rebuilt by Atlas from 18 frames, the man masked out. The take’s own sound.

01grey-grey-1123-0423.title: Out of Life
01grey-grey-1123-0423.about: Poem 01, a grey-box Genie 4 take seeded from inverse foundry, rebuilt by Atlas shot by shot. The people are cut out of the world; Sapiens2 tracks their bodies and Atlas depth sets them back in 3D. Pause and drag to walk round them.
